subject: english

knowledge.name: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?
Weekend activities 周末活动
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?
knowledge.explanation: go swimming、play badminton、visit grandparents、do homework、watch a film、read books 等动词短语，注意 go 后接动名词（go swimming）。

knowledge.name: What do you do at the weekend 问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?
knowledge.explanation: 问：What do you do at the weekend? 答：I usually play football. 注意 at the weekend 表示「在周末」。

knowledge.name: Frequency adverbs 频度副词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?
knowledge.explanation: always > usually > often > sometimes > never；位置在实义动词前（I often swim），在 be 动词后（I am always happy）。
prerequisites: What do you do at the weekend 问答

knowledge.name: like doing 表达喜好
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?
knowledge.explanation: like / enjoy 后接动名词：I like playing chess. 不要说 I like play chess.

chapters.name: Unit 1 What do we do at the weekend?

questions.analysis: go 后接动名词表示去做某项活动，go swimming 正确；go swim 缺 -ing，go to swim 不合习惯，going swim 形式错误。

questions.stem: — What do you do at the weekend? — I （  ） visit my grandparents.
questions.analysis: 这里需要副词修饰动词 visit，用 usually；usual 是形容词，usualy 拼写错，uses 是动词形式。
like 后接动名词，play 变 playing；写 to play 也可，但本单元重点为 like doing，且题干括号要求变形。

questions.stem: never 表示「从不」，比 sometimes 的频率更低。
questions.analysis: 频度从高到低为 always、usually、often、sometimes、never，never 是零频率，说法正确。
频度副词一般放在实义动词之前，A 正确；B 插在动词和宾语之间错误；C 句首位置可用于强调但不是常规语序；D 位置不合常规。

questions.stem: — What do you do （  ） the weekend? — I watch films.
questions.analysis: 固定搭配 at the weekend（在周末）；on the weekend 见于美式用法，但本教材用 at。
questions.knowledge_point: What do you do at the weekend 问答

questions.stem: 下列短语中，属于周末活动的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A 去游泳 ✓；B 看望祖父母 ✓；C 做作业 ✓；D 早起只是日常动作，不是本单元列举的周末活动短语 ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。

questions.stem: I am always busy at the weekend. 中 always 放在 be 动词之后是正确的。
questions.analysis: 频度副词在 be 动词后、实义动词前，am always busy 符合规则，说法正确。

questions.stem: 「我有时和朋友踢足球」的英文是（  ）
options: I sometimes play football with my friends.
I play sometimes football with my friends.
I sometime play football with my friends.
I am sometimes play football with my friends.
questions.analysis: sometimes 放在实义动词 play 之前，A 正确；B 位置错；C sometime 拼写错（sometime 指某时）；D 多余 am。
like 后接动名词，read 变 reading；likes 已加 s 表示第三人称单数，后面仍用动名词。

questions.stem: 关于频度副词，说法正确的有（  ）
options: 频度副词可放在实义动词前
频度副词不能和 be 动词同句使用
questions.analysis: A always 频率最高 ✓；B sometimes 低于 often ✓；C 放在实义动词前 ✓；D 频度副词可以和 be 动词连用（am always happy）✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。

questions.stem: I like play chess. 这句话语法正确。
questions.analysis: like 后要接动名词或不定式，应为 I like playing chess. 或 I like to play chess.，原句缺 -ing。

questions.stem: — How often do you go swimming? — （  ） a week.
questions.analysis: 问频率用次数表达，twice a week 表示每周两次；two 缺「次」的表达，second 是序数词，twice time 搭配错。

questions.stem: — What （  ） your sister do at the weekend? — She often draws pictures.
questions.analysis: 主语 your sister 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 does，后面动词用原形 do；写 do 则主谓不一致。
questions.knowledge_point: What do you do at the weekend 问答

questions.stem: 回答 What does he do at the weekend? 可以说 He goes swimming.
questions.analysis: 问句用 does he，答句动词加 s（goes），答法与问句一致，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: What do you do at the weekend 问答

questions.stem: 用英语写两句话，说说你周末通常做什么，要求用上一个频度副词和一个 like doing 结构。

answer.value: I usually play badminton at the weekend. I like reading books with my sister.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①用上频度副词且位置正确（1 分）；②用 like doing 结构（1 分）；③内容具体、句子通顺（1 分）；④大小写与标点（1 分）。like 后用动词原形不得分。

questions.stem: 把对话补全并译成中文：A: What do you do at the weekend? B: I （  ） go hiking. A: Do you like （  ）? B: Yes, I do.

answer.value: often；hiking。译文：A：你周末做什么？B：我常常去远足。A：你喜欢远足吗？B：是的，我喜欢。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：第一空 often（频度副词，位置在实义动词前）；第二空 hiking（like + 动名词）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两空正确（2 分）；②译文准确（2 分）；③大小写与标点（1 分）。第二空填 hike 则 like 后缺 -ing。
questions.knowledge_point: What do you do at the weekend 问答

questions.stem: 下面哪句与其他三句意思不同？（  ）
options: I always swim at the weekend.
I never miss swimming at the weekend.
I seldom swim at the weekend.
questions.analysis: A「周末总是游泳」、B「周末从不错过游泳」、C「每个周末都游泳」意思相近；D「周末很少游泳」与前三句相反，故选 D。
